test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ashu can row 7.5 km an hour in still water. He finds that it takes four times as much time to row upstream, as it takes to row downstream. The speed of the stream is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed in still water = 7.5 km/h

Time taken to row upstream = 4 × Time taken to row downstream

**Formula Used:**

Let the speed of the stream be x km/h.

Speed upstream = (7.5 - x) km/h

Speed downstream = (7.5 + x) km/h

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be d km.

Time taken to row upstream = d / (7.5 - x)

Time taken to row downstream = d / (7.5 + x)

Given: Time taken to row upstream = 4 × Time taken to row downstream

⇒ d / (7.5 - x) = 4 × (d / (7.5 + x))

⇒ 1 / (7.5 - x) = 4 / (7.5 + x)

⇒ 7.5 + x = 4 × (7.5 - x)

⇒ 7.5 + x = 30 - 4x

⇒ x + 4x = 30 - 7.5

⇒ 5x = 22.5

⇒ x = 22.5 / 5

⇒ x = 4.5 km/h

**The speed of the stream is 4.5 km/h.**
